R4_prev_in_tracks_all_cycles: prev_in updates on every posedge clk including reset cycles, so a 1-to-0 transition spanning a reset cycle is captured after reset deasserts
prev_in is not updated during reset cycles (or is reinitialized to the current in value on reset release), so a 1-to-0 transition spanning a reset cycle is not captured after reset deasserts
R2_capture_falling_edge: out is set combinationally in the same cycle the 1-to-0 transition is sampled (same_cycle visibility)
out is registered and reflects the falling-edge capture one clock cycle after the 1-to-0 transition is sampled (next_cycle visibility)

R_FALL: prev_in updates on every posedge including reset
Reset clears or disables previous input history for transition detection, so a 1 observed while reset=1 followed by 0 on the first reset=0 cycle is not captured; out remains 0.
